A mass balance of the RCF combined with FeCl3 catalysis
A process mass balance of the combination of RCF with 
FeCl3 catalysis was described based on 1.0 g of dried 
Eucalyptus (Fig. 7). Under optimized conditions, lignin 
component (ca. 269 mg) in biomass matrix can be depolymerized into monomers (134 mg), dimers and oligomers through RCF process, which could be solubilized in 
methanol. Under such a condition, the leftover solid 
residue, contained cellulose (343 mg), hemicellulose 
(133 mg) and Pd/C catalyst. Upon the treatment of FeCl3, 
the leftover carbohydrate pulp yielded furfural (74 mg) 
and levulinic acid (252 mg) in an integrated version.
